Need to retrain service staff
Nov 2023 • Friends
I am a relatively familiar customer of Milan Restaurant. However, the frequent changes in staff also surprised me. Some people are happy and enthusiastic, but others have poor attitudes and must be retrained many times. Today I ordered dinner at a restaurant. When I arrived, the table was arranged in the middle, a bit dark. I noticed that some of the tables by the window were empty, so I asked one of the staff if I could sit at the table near the window, because it might be late and no customers would come, or there might be another table where people had finished eating. about. But there was a female employee wearing glasses who showed a very unpleasant attitude, and then even signaled her colleague to deny it when I tried to ask another friend. This is unacceptable at a restaurant inside the Intercontinental Hotel. At the end of the session, the staff told me they had a cake and brought it out. This was a mistake in coordination between hotel departments, because I took the cake in the evening at the cafe bakery counter. But there was still that annoying employee wearing glasses, telling the other co-workers quite loudly "if you don't take the cake, throw it away". I don't understand what hatred this friend has towards me? Or hate Vietnamese customers (it seemed like I was the only Vietnamese customer at the restaurant at that time). I am a regular customer of the Milan restaurant, having had a PP membership card of the hotel continuously for 10 years. This is the first time I encountered this strange case.

Absolutely flawless service and phenomenal food
Jun 2021
Even during a short stay in Hanoi, travelers will note that the city offers an enormous variety of food at equally varied price-points. I will freely admit that my comfort zone is closer to street food options than the culinary excellence offered at Milan Restaurant. That said, I could not wait to share my rave review with anyone who cares to read this. I have now eaten a number of fantastic dinners at Milan and have never once been disappointed. The service is truly flawless - and the staff does a great job helping diners select not only the dishes they would most enjoy - but the staff also helps guest chose manners of preparation to best suit them. The risottos are amazing. The steaks are so tender (especially the rib eye and tenderloin) that I didn't not even need my knife. I am not a foodie by any means but I cannot stop raving about the quality of the food here.
